title: Count optimal unsigned one-source connector words in every characteristic
body:
## Summary

Prove a closed formula for the number of shortest unsigned one-source dirty-connector words over every finite characteristic m. The nonzero target coefficients have equal counts **if and only if m is prime**. This is a scoped proof with finite corroboration, with no new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```text
B: z += Bx; A: y += Az; target: y += c ABx
minimum length = 2m, for nonzero c modulo m
number of optimum words = (1/m) sum_{d|m} R_d(c) binom(2m/d,m/d)
R_d(c) = sum_{e|gcd(d,c)} e mu(d/e)
prime p: every nonzero c has [binom(2p,p)-2]/p words
```

The new result is the complete multiplicity law and prime/composite criterion. The elementary call floor is shared context from Riquelme Soares's #4189 and concurrent #4231. Ross Richardson's #943/#934 connector contract retains credit. Classical finite Fourier inversion and Ramanujan sums supply the counting method. Only `research/unsigned-connector-residue-count/` is added.

## Evidence

Before: #4189 gives six F3 optimal words. After: the written all-characteristic proof recovers that case, gives every coefficient count, and distinguishes composite characteristics. At m=4, coefficients 1,2,3 have 16,18,16 optimum words. Zero-target length-2m words include two pure words in addition to the balanced count; the zero target itself has empty optimum word.

Local CPython 3.12 checks pass:

- All 527 residues for m=2,...,32, using independent chronological DP and the divisor formula; all 250,950 position subsets for m=2,...,10.
- Literal dirty coefficient execution of 17,574 balanced words; all 21,840 unrestricted length-2m words at m=2,...,7, including 4,716 restored words.
- 496 attaining witnesses, 3,968 noncommuting two-coordinate dirty-input checks and 3,968 inverse roundtrips; eight semantic/domain controls.
- Both registered ordinary/optimized commands, with warnings as errors, take about 0.5 seconds each locally. These are individual check durations, not performance claims.
- Registered package replay, eight-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity and both Git-free exported modes pass. All nine export files remain unchanged. On-disk predecessor-input corruption is rejected by its SHA256 pin.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/unsigned-connector-residue-count/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unsigned-connector-residue-count
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/unsigned-connector-residue-count --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 path may replace the local interpreter path. Expected marker: `PASS_UNSIGNED_CONNECTOR_RESIDUE_COUNT moduli=31 residues=527`. The generated JSON receipt binds all package files and the live predecessor input. Final committed-export receipt SHA256: `5695bc7e1d369028089d97e887cfce8929f7371f4777f8c34b0d69011852b854`.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19080573 . Main remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. The card's first working control and selected binding baseline pass. The task metadata explicitly changes the assignment to this scheduling side result.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The proof is uniform in finite characteristic, compatible linear maps and row size in the stated unsigned complete-call interface. Finite executable corroboration stops at m=32. Calls must include their full implementation costs. A concrete supplier consumer, physical routing, admission, coefficient preparation, dispatch, precision and outer multiplication transfer remain uninstantiated. No selected cold replay or formal-kernel build was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No pending executable is imported.

## Open next questions

1. Can marginal spectra constrain simultaneous readout positions in a multi-source connector? Begin with one fixed path and retain correlations between coefficient demands.
2. Can an actual recursive caller choose among its minimum-length words to reduce fully charged routing? Pin one caller and compare complete access/head-return bills before further construction.

## Related open work

- #4189, head `5fb3936dfc8082f438f21c72dd6ca49ff4366ae7`: the unsigned F3 one-source predecessor. The formula gives `(20-2)/3=6`, agreeing with its six optimum words; minimum `2*3=6` also agrees, checked numerically. Its census is cited, not independently audited.
- #4231, inspected head `8a956cbc80dc55697fd3e214812ce567b5eca48f`: concurrent unsigned five-source characteristic classification. Its one-source `m*(1+1)=2m` floor agrees for all 31 tested characteristics. It does not give the new multiplicity distribution.
- #3919: one-source F2 direct-product alphabet comparison. Its old-alphabet minimum 4 agrees with `2*2=4`; the new formula counts its two optimum unsigned words. A fused direct-product call is outside this alphabet.
- #4225: five-source F3 binary demand. Its one-source projections have length 6, agreeing with `2*3=6`; its full 108-call batch is a different quantity, and no new batch optimum is asserted here.
- #4226 (closed as a duplicate of merged #2063, `research/connector-all-tariff-optimum`, which proves the same envelope): unequal-price five-source F2 envelope. Its 74-call batch and this one-source multiplicity law concern different demands; there is no overlapping five-source count to compare.
- #3897: a paid joint-output operation for one source and two F2 outputs. Restricting its original-alphabet count to one output gives `2+2=4`, agreeing with the one-output floor here, checked numerically. Joint-output pricing is excluded.
- #3909: an added paid arity-four source operation for a five-source F2 batch. The operation alphabet and five-source tariff differ; no shared one-source word-count number is claimed.

The committed-inputs-unchanged step also passed. All registered scientific commands and source checks passed locally; there is no unrun registered local obligation assigned to CI.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Only the new research package and its opt-in replay are added.
